wedding.title: Wedding
wedding.heroDescription: Complete floral styling to make your day truly magical
wedding.about: At MΩISIS Flower Design, we take care of every floral detail for your wedding. From the bridal bouquet to the church and reception decor, every element is designed with love and precision. Harris works closely with you to bring your dream atmosphere to life, using only the freshest and most exquisite flowers.

christening.title: Christenings
christening.heroDescription: Flowers that make the christening unforgettable
christening.about: We create unique floral arrangements for christenings that blend the joy of the moment with the elegance of fresh flowers. From soft pastels to bolder palettes, we tailor every creation to match the style and theme of your celebration.

graduation.title: Graduation
graduation.about: Graduation is a milestone that deserves to be celebrated with the most beautiful flowers. We create elegant bouquets and arrangements that express the pride and joy of this special day.

corporate.title: Corporate
corporate.heroDescription: Professional floral styling for every business need
corporate.about: We handle floral design for corporate events, conferences, grand openings, and office spaces. With professionalism and a refined aesthetic, we create arrangements that elevate any environment and impress your guests.

events.title: Events
events.heroDescription: Floral styling for every special moment
events.about: From graduations and corporate events to private celebrations, we handle the floral design for every occasion. With creativity and attention to detail, we transform any space into a unique experience.

anniversary.title: Anniversary - Love
anniversary.heroDescription: Express your feelings with unique floral arrangements
anniversary.about: Every anniversary and moment of love deserves the most beautiful flowers. We create romantic bouquets and stunning arrangements that express your deepest feelings. From classic roses to original creations, every bouquet is a declaration of love.

birthday.title: Birthday - Name Day
birthday.heroDescription: Joyful floral arrangements for every celebration
birthday.about: Birthday or name day? We create joyful and vibrant floral arrangements that bring smiles. We customize every bouquet to match the style and preferences of the celebrant, for a gift they'll remember.

birth.title: New Baby
birth.about: The arrival of a baby is the most joyful moment. We create soft, tender arrangements in pastel tones that express the joy and love for the newest family member.

graduation.title: Graduation
graduation.about: Graduation is a milestone that deserves to be celebrated with the most beautiful flowers. We create elegant bouquets and arrangements that express the pride and joy of this special day.

housewarming.title: Housewarming
housewarming.heroDescription: Bring life to your new space
housewarming.about: A new home or a new business deserves a bright beginning. We create floral arrangements and plants that bring vitality, color and positive energy to every new space.

condolence.title: Sympathy
condolence.about: In difficult times, flowers express what words cannot. We create respectful and elegant sympathy arrangements, with care and sensitivity to every detail.
